original_inspection.locator: Introduction lines 74-98; section 3.1 lines 295-318; SFT validation-selection paragraph lines 420-424
original_inspection.finding: Pretrained next-token objective differs from instruction following; demonstrations plus human comparisons plus reward/PPO are one post-training recipe; validation loss need not agree with preference ratings.

original_inspection.locator: Section 4 pp.4-5, Eq.7 and DPO outline
original_inspection.finding: Fixed pi_ref ratios enter policy loss on same-prompt preferred/rejected responses; no separate reward fitting; practical starting reference is SFT when available, else preference-response MLE.

original_inspection.locator: Section 3, Low-Rank Constraint on Update Matrices, p.3, Eq.3
original_inspection.finding: Frozen W0 with trainable A,B, low-rank r much smaller than d,k; preserve base and add BAx. No claim of automatically better quality or proportional total memory.

original_inspection.locator: Sections 1-2 pp.1-2, perfect-calibration Eq.1 and acc/conf bin definitions
original_inspection.finding: Class confidence is distinct from correctness; calibration compares confidence with accuracy across held-out predictions. Does not provide full-response probability of truth.

original_inspection.locator: Section 2.2 opening and section 2.2.2 Reward Modeling pp.5-6
original_inspection.finding: RL starts from base; math answer verification/compiler tests and format rewards provide post-training feedback. They are rule-based, not human ratings.
exp(x_i)/sum_j exp(x_j), explicit candidate axis; source tag v2.9.0 and local execution v2.14.1+cpu are distinct evidence scopes.
Input logits unnormalized; one-hot index CE is negative target log probability; mean is over specified nonignored terms, with optional weights.

original_inspection.locator: Automatic Differentiation introduction; Computing Gradients; computational graph/backward
original_inspection.finding: Loss partial derivatives with fixed inputs and targets, followed by separate parameter updates; backward itself only computes/accumulates derivatives.
Batch size is number of samples per loaded group; collation combines samples into a minibatch; final batch may be smaller.

original_inspection.locator: Saving & Loading a General Checkpoint lines 256-315
original_inspection.finding: Saving model and optimizer state plus epoch/progress for continuation; rebuild objects and load both state dictionaries.
